title: A Journey that is on sale or that people paid for cannot be deleted

source.ref: Journey audit 2026-11-17 (project thread: Dial in the Journey Wizard and Journeys)

detail: deleteJourney (the editor Danger zone and the manage card) and the curator's deleteJourneyPlanAction called deletePlan with no check for a sale. A plan delete cascades to its product (commerce_products.journey_plan_id on delete cascade, migration 20270345005900) and with it the product's reviews and variants, and to every enrolment, so a buyer lost the program they paid for although the sell header promises 'people who paid keep what they bought'. Fixed 2026-11-17: lib/journeys/paid.ts journeyDeleteBlocker refuses while any non-archived product sells the Journey ('Take it off sale first') or any enrolment carries an order_id ('Set it to private to hide it; buyers keep their access'), and refuses on a failed read since a delete cannot be undone. Both delete actions call it first. Guarded by lib/journeys/delete-blocker.test.ts.

verify.note: Fails if journeyDeleteBlocker stops checking live offers or paid enrolments, or either delete action stops calling it.
